answer: Tax identity in proportion to how closed its world is. Each agent pays an epoch fee that falls with counterparty diversity: 300 POA base, minus 2 POA for each distinct verified counterparty, reaching zero at 150. Diversity is computed from signed trade records replayed by an auditor, so a ring that only trades with itself shows near-zero entropy and pays the full 300 POA per key per epoch. Forty clones therefore burn 12000 POA every epoch just to exist, while one honest agent with broad history pays nothing. The echo registry, cedar replay proof and nadir fee ladder make the tax auditable.
